appMode.title: App mode
appMode.desc: Switch between Home Organizer and Moving Planner

push.title: Push notifications
push.desc: Reminders for tasks, supplies and maintenance

kochbuch.title: Cookbook imports
kochbuch.desc: Daily limits for recipe and video imports

assistant.title: Global assistant
assistant.desc: AI assistant for questions and actions across the app

appMode.intro: Choose which area you primarily use. You can switch at any time.
appMode.deactivatedInfo: Moving Planner is permanently disabled. You will always stay in Home Organizer, even after a restart or on new devices.
appMode.deactivateInfo: Move complete? Permanently disable the Moving Planner — it stays saved and can be re-enabled at any time.

household.removeConfirm: {{name}} will be removed from the household immediately and will lose access.

invite.intro: Invite new people by email. They can join even without an existing account: open the link, register/sign in, and the invitation is accepted automatically.

ki.memberIntro: The AI configuration is managed by the household admin. You can see the current status here.
ki.ollamaUrlHint: Base URL only, no path — e.g. https://my-server.com or http://localhost:11434
ki.ollamaNote: Note: In Ollama mode, voice input is processed via the browser's Web Speech API instead of Whisper.
ki.openaiModelHint: This model is used for the global AI assistant. Custom models must support Chat Completions.
ki.lmstudioUrlHint: Address of your LM Studio server, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:1234
ki.lmstudioKeyPlaceholder: API key (optional, only if your server requires one)
ki.lmstudioNote: LM Studio runs locally on your network — data never leaves your home.
ki.claudeModelHint: Default: claude-opus-4-8. Use model IDs exactly as shown, do not append date suffixes.

imageAnalysis.intro: Choose the mode for AI-powered receipt recognition. This setting applies to the entire household.
imageAnalysis.chatgptVisionDesc: OpenAI Vision analyses the image directly
imageAnalysis.ocrRegelnDesc: Text extraction, no API key required
imageAnalysis.ocrOllamaDesc: OCR text is passed to Ollama
imageAnalysis.apiKeyNote: Independent of the AI settings. Only used for receipt analysis.
imageAnalysis.openaiModelHint: This model must support image input. It only applies to receipt-scanner image analysis.
imageAnalysis.ollamaModelNote: A separate model for image analysis (must have vision capabilities).
imageAnalysis.lmstudioVisionDesc: Local vision model via LM Studio
imageAnalysis.lmstudioModelNote: Vision-capable model on the LM Studio server, e.g. qwen2.5-vl. Empty = text model from AI settings.
imageAnalysis.claudeVisionNote: Claude Vision uses the Anthropic API key and Claude model from the AI settings.

push.intro: Receive notifications even when the app is closed — for tasks, supplies, maintenance, and deadlines.
push.iosHint: On iOS, push notifications must be enabled via Safari and the app must first be added to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen).
push.notSupported: Push notifications are not supported by this browser.
push.permissionHint: Please grant permission in your browser settings.
push.shoppingReminderDesc: Remind me daily when there are unfinished items in the shopping list

tours.autoStartNote: Automatic start depends on the "Automatic tours" setting.

mobileNav.intro: Customise the {{count}} middle slots of the mobile navigation bar. The first (Home/Dashboard) and last slot (More) are fixed.

account.deleteWarning: All data will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

kochbuch.intro: Daily limits apply per household and protect against accidental costs from video downloads, transcription, and AI analysis. Failed imports do not count.
kochbuch.ollamaUrlHint: This URL is saved in the existing Ollama configuration and used server-side by the cookbook.
kochbuch.ollamaThinkingHint: Can improve quality with reasoning models, but is slower and increases timeout risk.
kochbuch.aiProviderLmstudioDesc: Dedicated LM Studio model for the cookbook
kochbuch.aiProviderClaudeDesc: Dedicated Claude model for the cookbook

assistant.intro: The global assistant answers questions about your household data and can create new entries on request. Every action must be confirmed in the chat.
assistant.enableHint: Shows or hides the assistant just for you. Other household members are not affected.
assistant.aiProviderOpenaiDesc: Dedicated OpenAI model for the assistant
assistant.aiProviderOllamaDesc: Dedicated Ollama model for the assistant
assistant.ollamaModelHint: A model with tool support is recommended for tool calls (e.g. qwen2.5, llama3.1). Without tool support the assistant automatically falls back to simple mode.
assistant.ollamaThinkingHint: Only relevant for reasoning models. Disabled by default for faster answers.
assistant.adminOnlyHint: The assistant AI provider is managed by the household admin.
assistant.aiProviderLmstudioDesc: Dedicated LM Studio model for the assistant
assistant.aiProviderClaudeDesc: Dedicated Claude model for the assistant
assistant.lmstudioModelHint: A model with tool support is recommended for tool calls (e.g. qwen2.5).
assistant.claudeModelHint: Claude supports tool calling natively — ideal for the assistant.

modelSelect.unavailableDescription: Saved, but not returned for the current API key
modelSelect.unknownDescription: Capability is not reported by the Models API
modelSelect.loadTimeout: The model catalogue is not responding. You can enter a model ID manually or refresh the list.
modelSelect.changedRequiresTest: Model changed. Test unknown capabilities before saving.
modelSelect.notSuitable: This model is not suitable for the selected use case.
modelSelect.assistantHint: The assistant model must support function tools.
modelSelect.cookbookHint: Recipe imports require structured JSON output.
